title: Government's Obligation to Utilise Funds in a Prescribed Manner

content.scenario: The Government of India has collected funds under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, for the purpose of consumer welfare. The Government must utilise these funds in a manner prescribed by the Act.
content.outcome: The Government shall utilise the funds collected under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019, in such manner as may be prescribed, as per the provisions of Section 39(2) of the Act.

user_queries: How must the Government utilise funds collected under the Consumer Protection Act?
What are the rules for utilising consumer protection funds?
In what manner can the Government use the funds collected for consumer welfare?
